analytic_bridge.falsification_consequence: Failure eliminates full block collapse and names the first exact residue correction that a weaker endpoint proof must retain.
analytic_bridge.survival_consequence: Survival opens a symbolic q-Lucas/Pochhammer proof whose quotient sum is exactly the committed Phi_1 harmonic moment.

experiment_contract.authority_boundary: Experiment metadata and finite computation are evidence, not proof authority; claim status changes only through Lean, an exact counterexample, or the named owner verifier.

hypothesis.statement: After scalar extraction, B=2C and both channels separately obey the same quotient-block law K_d^(q-1)c_q, uniformly over residue classes s, with c_q=(q!)^3 H_q/12^(q-1).

probe.computation: Construct S_n=(-B_n-C_n)U_n exactly in QQ[p]/(Phi_d) for d<=n<5d, infer K_d=S_(2d)/S_d, and compare every q=2,3,4, 0<=s<d source residue against the Phi_1 harmonic prediction.
probe.falsifier: Any nonzero exact block-law difference in either source channel, or any failure of B=2C, kills the strong block-collapse mechanism.
probe.question: Does the stronger source-row block law hold in every residue class, including the new degree-four d=5 strip?
probe.stop_condition: Stop after the complete d=1,...,5 strips decide the mechanism; do not substitute further index sampling for the symbolic reduction.

problem.claim_ceiling: Exact full-strip block-collapse decisions at d=1,...,5 and q=2,3,4; not an all-d theorem or irrationality proof.
problem.target_statement: Prove irrationality of the Lambert value at p=3/2.

progress.authority_boundary: This classification routes research attention; it does not promote finite evidence to proof authority.
progress.decision_basis: The channelwise full residue strip strictly strengthens the committed endpoint recurrence, tests reduction to one source channel, and either exposes an analytic source identity or kills it.
progress.next_analytic_target: Derive the block-collapse symbolically by splitting the terminating source sum at n=qd+s into quotient and residue variables, proving that the quotient sum is the normalized Phi_1 harmonic moment.

result.summary: For every d=1,...,5, q=2,3,4, and 0<=s<d, the exact B and C source channels separately satisfy S_(qd+s)=K_d^(q-1)c_q S_(d+s), with the same K_d and c_q=(q!)^3 H_q/12^(q-1). Moreover B=2C throughout every complete source strip, so the combined collapse is three times a single channel and cannot depend on B/C cancellation. All source bases and multipliers are nonzero, all primitive mu coefficients vanish, and the finite q-Lucas regressions hold. This opens a uniform root-of-unity block-collapse proof from one Zudilin source sum to the Phi_1 harmonic kernel.

result.authority_boundary: The exact computation decides every listed quotient/residue identity at the listed cyclotomic indices. It does not prove the identity for all d or all quotient blocks.
